newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA MOTHERSON SUMI BONUS MEET ON AUG 8.
newsitem.headline: INDIA MOTHERSON SUMI BONUS MEET ON AUG 8.

text.p: The board of Indian auto ancillary maker, Motherson Sumi Systems will meet for a bonus share issue on August 8, the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) said in a notice on Thursday.
Motherson shares jumped 9.60 rupees, or 8.5 percent, to 122.50 at the National Stock Exchange in early morning trade with only bidders in the stock, dealers said.
On Wednesday, Motherson shares closed at 116.75 rupees at the BSE.
